# windowsddi_dns_zones (Data Source)

Lists the DNS zones on the server (`Get-DnsServerZone`), primary zones and conditional forwarders included. Zones the server creates automatically (`TrustAnchors`, `0.in-addr.arpa`, ...) are left out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every reverse lookup zone on the server.
data "windowsddi_dns_zones" "reverse" {
  reverse = true
}

output "reverse_zones" {
  value = data.windowsddi_dns_zones.reverse.zones[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ad_integrated` (Boolean) When set, only AD-integrated zones (`true`) or only zones not stored in Active Directory (`false`) are returned.
- `reverse` (Boolean) When set, only reverse lookup zones (`true`) or only forward zones (`false`) are returned.

### Read-Only

- `zones` (Attributes List) Matching zones, in the order the server returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `ad_integrated` (Boolean) Whether the zone is stored in Active Directory.
- `dynamic_update` (String) Dynamic update mode (`None`, `Secure` or `NonsecureAndSecure`). Null for zone types without one.
- `forwarder_timeout` (Number) Forwarder timeout in seconds for a conditional forwarder, null otherwise.
- `master_servers` (List of String) Master servers of a conditional forwarder, in order. Empty for other zone types.
- `name` (String) Zone name, lowercase without trailing dot.
- `replication_scope` (String) AD replication scope (`Forest`, `Domain`, `Legacy` or `Custom`). Null when the zone is not AD-integrated.
- `reverse` (Boolean) Whether the zone is a reverse lookup zone.
- `zone_file` (String) Zone file name for file-backed zones, null otherwise.
- `zone_type` (String) Zone type as reported by `Get-DnsServerZone`: `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Stub` or `Forwarder` (conditional forwarder).
